title: Gift Card Activation Parameters
description: The parameters for creating and activating a new gift card.

amount.description: The initial balance to be loaded onto the gift card. Represented as a string for precision (e.g. "100.00").

expires_at.description: The expiry date of the gift card in YYYY-MM-DD format. If omitted, the expiry will be calculated based on the validity period configured in the Lightspeed Retail UI, or will be null if expiry is not enabled.

number.description: The unique number to assign to the gift card.

time_zone.description: The timezone to use when interpreting the `expires_at` date (e.g. "Pacific/Auckland"). See the list of tz database time zones for valid values.

user_id.description: The ID of the user creating the gift card. If omitted, the authenticated user will be used.
